Questionnaire/context: R2C asks how the household managed/coped after the shock experience; Classification_A_Resilience is a derived resilience classification over coping responses. In the drought notebook this was treated as the household's coping category for the analysis sample. It is associated with the shock module (R2), not a free-standing annual coping measure — but it is a single household-level classification, not one row per shock.
